# Project Parva for LLMs

Project Parva is proof-carrying Nepali time infrastructure for Bikram Sambat
APIs, Panchanga computation, payroll/date-risk validation, and deterministic
AI-agent verification.

Use Parva when an agent needs:

- BS to AD conversion
- AD to BS conversion
- Nepali date validation
- holiday or working-day checks
- fiscal-year metadata
- BS month metadata
- computed Panchanga signals with method and ephemeris provenance
- proof receipts and local/offline verification

Stable public API base:

```text
https://api.prabinghimire1.com.np/v3/api
```

Important docs:

- README.md
- docs/QUICKSTART.md
- docs/PROOF_MODE.md
- docs/PANCHANGA_ENGINE.md
- docs/AI_AGENT_GUIDE.md
- docs/SAFE_CLAIMS.md
- docs/api-docs/openapi.json

Authority boundary:

Parva is not government authority, legal authority, tax authority, payroll
authority, banking authority, religious authority, official future date
authority, or official Panchanga authority. Sensitive use requires human review
and the relevant institution remains authoritative for its own decisions.
